description: Defines the DnsUdpTracker class responsible for tracking DNS UDP query data, including metrics on port reuse, ID mismatches, and entropy detection within the Chromium project.

classes.name: DnsUdpTracker
classes.description: Tracks DNS UDP query data, port reuse, ID mismatches, and entropy status for network security and performance metrics.

methods.name: RecordQuery
methods.description: Records a DNS query with specified port and query ID.

methods.name: RecordResponseId
methods.description: Records a response ID associated with a query ID.

methods.name: low_entropy
methods.description: Returns whether low entropy in UDP port and DNS ID has been detected.

methods.name: set_tick_clock_for_testing
methods.description: Sets a custom tick clock for testing purposes.
